report_markdown:
# Dental software lead list

Checked: 2026-11-14. **5 of 5 accounts found; 8 contacts.** Each account's own site confirms product fit. US headquarters and 11–200 employees are per Apollo search filters; exact headcounts are not independently verified. No outreach performed.

## Accounts

| Company | Domain | Why it fits | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| AirPay | airpay.dental | Dental insurance verification and pre-claim workflow software. | [Website](https://airpay.dental/) |
| Practice by Numbers | practicenumbers.com | Patient reminders, two-way texting and PMS-integrated online booking. | [Website](https://practicenumbers.com/) |
| SOTA Cloud | sotacloud.com | Cloud dental imaging integrating sensors, PMS and capture-to-claim workflows. | [Website](https://sotacloud.com/) |
| Oryx Dental | oryxdental.com | Dental practice management, imaging, messaging, booking and revenue-cycle software. | [Website](https://www.oryxdental.com/) |
| tab32 | tab32.com | Cloud dental scheduling, imaging, charting, billing and patient communication. | [Website](https://tab32.com/) |

## Contacts

| Name | Title | Company | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Derek Giddon | COFOUNDER / CEO | AirPay | [Leadership page](https://airpay.dental/about-us) |
| Austin Fr***k | Head of Sales | AirPay | monid:apollo/mixed_people/api_search |
| Rohit Ga***g | Founder and President | Practice by Numbers | monid:apollo/mixed_people/api_search |
| Aditi Ag***l | Co-Founder | Practice by Numbers | monid:apollo/mixed_people/api_search |
| Albert Kim | Chief Executive Officer | SOTA Cloud | monid:apollo/mixed_people/api_search |
| Rania Sa***h | Founder & CEO | Oryx Dental | monid:apollo/mixed_people/api_search |
| Kellan An***w | Head of Sales | Oryx Dental | monid:apollo/mixed_people/api_search |
| Lonna Yen | Co-founder | tab32 | monid:apollo/mixed_people/api_search |

## Near misses

- **Atomica AI:** Site emphasizes CAD, implant planning, restorations and scanner hardware; excluded under a narrow reading of the requested categories.
- **Dexis:** Returned domain is a national-security/program-delivery business, not dental software.
- **3Sixty:** Site emphasizes treatment-planning services, guides and radiology reports; qualifying software was not clear.

## Gaps and assumptions

- US means US-headquartered; listed product categories were treated as scope boundaries.
- CEO, Founder and Head of Sales were inferred because no offering or titles were provided; they are entry points rather than confirmed buyers.
- Size and headquarters depend on Apollo filters, with no exact headcounts independently verified. AirPay's site also confirms New York.
- Most contacts are supported only by Apollo. Masked surnames are unchanged. SOTA Cloud and tab32 each had one matching contact.
- AirPay had conflicting CEO records in Apollo; its own leadership page supports Derek Giddon, so the conflicting record was omitted.
